verse: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).
story: Joseph has decided to end his engagement quietly when an angel tells him the child is of the Holy Spirit.

Matthew pauses to say that all this fulfils what Isaiah spoke: a virgin will conceive and bear a son, and His name will be Immanuel. Matthew translates it for his readers so that nobody misses it. The name is a statement about who is in the manger. God has not sent a message from a distance; He has come to live among His people, and the child will save them from their sins.
Whatever this season holds for you, you are not facing it with God far off. He has made Himself near.
